title.suggested: Old ring expert traces the world heavyweight title back past Allen

summary.suggested: The St. Louis Star ran Damon Runyon's column quoting Charles Mathison, who argued the world title did not pass from Tom Allen to Joe Goss in 1876 because Jem Mace had beaten Allen in 1870.

metadata.notes: masthead reads THE ST. LOUIS STAR, Tuesday evening, May 1, 1928

facts.fact: Jem Mace beat Allen by knockout in ten rounds at Kennerville for the world heavyweight championship; Allen then held the American title
Joe Goss beat Allen on a foul; only Allen's American title was at stake

notes: Retrospective opinion piece; the image prints Kennerville 'Io.' (a typo for La.).
